name: Pizza Casserole
description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Cabbage Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy cabbage casserole with a crunchy bread crumb topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook cabbage wedges until tender, then drain and cut into large pieces.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour, and milk. Season with salt, grated cheese, and Cheez Whiz.
Combine cooked cabbage with the white sauce mixture.
Top with crumbled buttered bread.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: cabbage casserole, creamy vegetable dish, comforting main course

_similar.name: Supreme Broccoli Soup Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole with a crunchy crouton topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Place cooked broccoli in a 9x9 inch pan.
Mix together mushroom soup, flour, sour cream, and seasonings. Pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle grated carrot, chopped onion, and croutons over the top.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 325°F for 1/2 hour.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, creamy soup casserole, baked vegetable dish

_similar.name: Creamy Chicken Stew
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting chicken stew with vegetables in a creamy sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook and stir until the chicken is browned. Drain.
Add raw vegetables, basil, bay leaf, celery salt, and 5 cups broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Add canned vegetables. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
In a saucepan, mix flour and butter or margarine until smooth. Gradually whisk in remaining 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Pour the sauce into the Dutch oven. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rolls or biscuits.

_similar.keywords: chicken stew, creamy stew, comfort food

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food
